title: Digital Animation Intern
note: 2D/3D animation and visualization in the Polaris design studio; must be a U.S. person.

facts.summary: Intern in the Polaris Design studio who makes 2D/3D animation and visualization of vehicle concepts.
facts.duties: Animates vehicle designs and features, makes motion graphics for design reviews, and prepares assets for rendering and VR.
facts.requirements: Portfolio of animation or visualization work, plus Blender, Maya, C4D, After Effects or Unreal. ID and transportation design students are welcome.
facts.apply: Apply through Polaris Workday. A portfolio is required.
